createWorkflow.title: Create a workflow
createWorkflow.description: Create the template your jobs run under: how candidates are reached, when, and which checks run by default. Only `name` and `schedule` are required. Returns `workflow_id`.

fields.name: Display name, 1–200 characters.
fields.external_id: Your own id (A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -, up to 128). Must be unique.
fields.default_methods: Optional. Checks a mandate uses when it sends none: `data_enrichment`, `skill_verification`, `interest_collection`. Leave out for all three.
fields.delivery: Optional. Channels: `whatsapp`, `voice_call`, `sms_backup` (true / false). Leave out for all three on.
fields.schedule: Required. Send all six: `start_time` and `end_time` ("HH:MM"), `days` (mon…sun, at least one), `timezone` (IANA), `max_retries` 1 to 3, `retry_after_hours` 6, 8 or 12.

errors: `name` or `schedule` missing, a `schedule` key missing, empty or repeated `days`, time not HH:MM, or an unknown field.
`external_id` is already used by another workflow.

listWorkflows.title: List workflows
listWorkflows.description: List your organisation’s blue-collar workflows (made here or in the playground).

updateWorkflow.title: Update a workflow
updateWorkflow.description: Change only the fields you send (send at least one), for example the send window. Fields not listed below cannot be changed.

fields.name: 1–200 characters.
fields.status: `active`, `inactive` or `draft`. To archive, use `DELETE`; `archived` cannot be set here.
fields.external_id: Must not be used by another workflow (`409 CONFLICT`).
fields.delivery: `whatsapp`, `voice_call`, `sms_backup`. Only the keys you send change.
fields.schedule: Send `start_time` and `end_time` together. Other keys merge; `days` is replaced as a whole list.
fields.default_methods: 1–3 different values of `data_enrichment`, `skill_verification`, `interest_collection`. It only decides the checks of mandates that send no `methods` of their own, so existing mandates keep theirs.
fields.verification_methods: Record switches both on for every workflow. Sending it (or any other unknown field) is refused with `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`.

errors: Empty body, `verification_methods` or another unknown field, a time not HH:MM, only one of start_time / end_time, or a bad value.
Workflow was made in the playground; the API can only read it.
Workflow is archived, or `external_id` is taken.

deleteWorkflow.title: Archive a workflow
deleteWorkflow.description: Retire a workflow you no longer use. It is archived, not erased.
errors: Workflow was made in the playground.
It still has open mandates. Archive them first.

searchSkills.title: Search skills
searchSkills.description: Type-ahead: find skills by a few letters (e.g. “fork”) and keep the `skill_id` the recruiter picks.
errors: `q` shorter than 2 characters, or only wildcards.

listSkillDomains.title: List skill domains
listSkillDomains.description: The top of the skill tree: all primary domains, for a browse menu.

browseSubDomainSkills.title: List skills in a sub-domain
browseSubDomainSkills.description: The skills inside one sub-domain, 50 per page (700 at most).
errors: More than 200 browse pages in an hour.

lookupSkills.title: Look up skills
lookupSkills.description: Check up to 50 skill ids you stored: still `active`, or `not_found` (removed)?
errors: More than 50 ids, repeated ids, or a bad id format.

matchSkills.title: Match text to skills
matchSkills.description: Turn free text into official skills; `suggestion` is `auto` (use it), `confirm` (ask the recruiter) or `none`.

extractSkills.title: Extract skills from a job
extractSkills.description: Suggest skills from a job title and description. Nothing is saved.

createSkillRequest.title: Request a skill
createSkillRequest.description: Ask Record to add a skill that search could not find. Returns `request_id`.

listSkillRequests.title: List skill requests
listSkillRequests.description: See every skill you asked for and where it stands.

getSkillRequest.title: Get a skill request
getSkillRequest.description: Check one skill request, for example whether Record approved it.

searchLocations.title: Search places in India
searchLocations.description: Type-ahead for a job’s place in India: matches the start of district and place names (up to 8 districts and 25 places). Use the place `name` as `location.city` and its `state` as `location.state`. For a job abroad use `GET /countries`.
errors: `q` missing, shorter than 2 or longer than 60 characters.

listCountries.title: List countries
listCountries.description: Every country an abroad job can be in, A to Z, in one answer (about 250): filter it in your own picker. Send the `code` of each pick as `countries` on a mandate with `location_type: "abroad"` (1–10). India is listed with `abroad_selectable: false`: jobs in India use `location`.

listEmploymentTypes.title: List employment types
listEmploymentTypes.description: The choices of the playground’s Employment type dropdown. Send one as `employment_type` of a mandate so it shows as a choice there. Other text is still accepted and kept as sent.

listShifts.title: List shifts
listShifts.description: The choices of the playground’s Shift dropdown. Send one as `shift` of a mandate. Other text is still accepted and kept as sent.

createMandate.title: Create a job mandate
createMandate.description: Create the job Record verifies candidates against. Returns `mandate_id`; questions are prepared in the background.

fields.skills: `{ skill_id, verify }` or `{ name, pending: true }` (a skill you requested). 5–10 recommended, max 10; max 3 with `verify: true`.
fields.methods: Which checks run. Leave out to use the workflow’s `default_methods`.
fields.enrichment_questions: 1–5 items (up to 10 when `data_enrichment` is the only method) `{ key, type: yes_no | voice, text, knockout: yes | no, required }`. Needed when `data_enrichment` is on.
fields.job_id: Your own job id. If you send it, it must not be in use.
fields.location_type: `india` (default) or `abroad`. Same as the playground’s Abroad option.
fields.location: A place in India: `{ city, state?, pincode? }` (find it with `GET /locations`). Not allowed when `location_type` is `abroad`.
fields.countries: Needed when `location_type` is `abroad`: 1–10 different ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes such as `SG` (list them with `GET /countries`; lower case is accepted and stored upper case). India (`IN`) cannot be picked. Not allowed for an India job.
fields.experience: `{ min_years, max_years }`, whole years 0–50, `max_years` at least `min_years`. Send both. Leave it out to clear it on a replace.
fields.employment_type, shift: Pick from `GET /employment-types` (Full-time, Part-time, Contract, …) and `GET /shifts` (Day shift, Night shift, Rotational, General). Other text up to 100 characters is kept as sent.
fields.interest_collection: `other_roles` is only saved and returned. It does not change what candidates are asked: the interest prompt is fixed, and `methods` switches it on or off.

errors: Unknown skill, `verify` on a skill that cannot be verified, repeated skill / question key, a check without its data, `abroad` without `countries` (or with `location`), `countries` on an India job, an unknown or non-selectable country code, or experience above 50 years.
More than 10 skills, 3 verified skills or 5 questions.
That workflow was made in the playground.
Workflow is archived, or `job_id` is already used.

getMandateById.title: Get a job mandate
getMandateById.description: Read the mandate. Repeat until `status` is `ready` (questions prepared) before expecting candidates to be contacted. `location_type` says where the job is: for `india`, `location` holds the place; for `abroad`, `countries` lists `{ code, name }` and `location` is null. `location_names` is every place or country name as the playground shows it.

listMandates.title: List job mandates
listMandates.description: List your organisation’s job mandates (made here or in the playground).

getMandateQuestionsById.title: Get mandate questions
getMandateQuestionsById.description: See what a candidate will be asked, in `en` `ta` `hi` `kn` `te` or `ml` (English where a translation is not ready). Read-only: change them with `PUT …/questions`.

setMandateQuestionsById.title: Update mandate questions
setMandateQuestionsById.description: The write side of `GET …/questions`: replace the screening questions, or ask Record to write new skill questions. One part per call.

fields.enrichment_questions: Replaces the screening questions (1–5, or 10 with enrichment only), exactly like `PUT …/enrichment-questions`. Send this part alone.
fields.skill_questions.regenerate: `"all"` or the slots to write again, e.g. `[0, 2]` (the `index` in `GET …/questions`). Record writes the new text; you cannot supply or edit it. Send this part alone.
fields.interest questions: A fixed prompt per language. Switch it on or off with `methods`.

errors: Both parts or neither, repeated or out-of-range slots, extra fields (such as your own question text), or `skill_verification` is not on this mandate.
More than 5 screening questions (10 when `data_enrichment` is the only method).
Mandate was made in the playground.
Archived, still `preparing` (wait Retry-After), or over 10 changes this hour.

updateMandateById.title: Replace a job mandate
updateMandateById.description: Replace the whole mandate (send the full body again). An identical resend changes nothing.
errors: Mandate was made in the playground.
Archived; `workflow_id` differs; still `preparing` (wait Retry-After); or over 10 changes this hour.
More than 10 skills, 3 verified skills or 5 questions.

setMandateMethodsById.title: Update mandate checks
setMandateMethodsById.description: Change only which checks run on the mandate.
errors: Mandate was made in the playground.
Archived, still `preparing`, or too many changes this hour.
Empty / repeated methods, or a check without its data.

setMandateSkillsById.title: Replace mandate skills
setMandateSkillsById.description: Replace only the skill list. Changing the verified skills regenerates the skill questions.
errors: Mandate was made in the playground.
Archived, still `preparing`, or too many changes this hour.

setMandateEnrichmentQuestionsById.title: Replace screening questions
setMandateEnrichmentQuestionsById.description: Replace only the screening questions (1 to 5, or 10 with enrichment only).
errors: Mandate was made in the playground.
Archived, still `preparing`, or too many changes this hour.
A `type` other than `yes_no` / `voice`, an `options` field, or a repeated `key`.

archiveMandateById.title: Archive a job mandate
archiveMandateById.description: Close the job when it is filled: no new campaigns start, running ones finish, results stay readable.
errors: Mandate was made in the playground.

deleteMandateById.title: Delete a job mandate
deleteMandateById.description: Same as archive. Nothing is erased; collected results stay readable.
errors: Mandate was made in the playground.

createCampaign.title: Create a campaign
createCampaign.description: Send your candidates (name + phone) for a mandate. Record contacts and verifies them. Returns `campaign_id`.

fields.mandate_id: From step 2 (or send your own `job_id` instead, never both).
fields.start: `now` sends at once; `manual` only creates a draft (start it later).
fields.candidates: 1–1,000 of `{ name, phone, external_id? }`. Phone: 10 digits or with country code. Bad numbers come back in `rejected`.
fields.name, external_id, language: Campaign name, your unique id for it, language `en` `hi` `ta` `te` `kn` `ml` (default `en`).

errors: Both or neither of `mandate_id` / `job_id`, or no usable phone number.
Not enough credits (1 per candidate when skill verification is on).
TEST key with a number not on its list, or the mandate was made in the playground.
Mandate is archived, or campaign `external_id` is taken.

getCampaign.title: Get a campaign
getCampaign.description: See whether it has gone out, is waiting for the job’s questions, is paused or stuck, and how many are contacted. `candidate_list` holds its first candidates (100 by default; `candidates_limit` up to 200, or 0 to leave it out) with their `candidate_id`, `delivery` and `can_resend`; `has_more` says there are more. For all of them, with verdicts and answers, call `GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/candidates`.

listCampaigns.title: List campaigns
listCampaigns.description: List your organisation’s campaigns; filter by `mandate_id` to see one job’s.

startCampaign.title: Start a campaign
startCampaign.description: Start a campaign you created with `start: manual`. It starts once.
errors: Campaign was made in the playground, or TEST key number not allowed.
Already started, or the job is archived.

addCampaignCandidates.title: Add candidates
addCampaignCandidates.description: Add more people (up to 1,000 a call). A number already in the campaign is skipped, so resending is safe.
errors: Campaign was made in the playground, or TEST key number not allowed.
Campaign is completed / cancelled, or the job is archived.
More than 20,000 candidates in the campaign.
No usable phone number in the batch.

resendCampaignCandidateLink.title: Resend a candidate link
resendCampaignCandidateLink.description: Send one candidate’s link again over WhatsApp (and SMS) if they have not received or opened it. Get the `candidate_id` from `GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/candidates` (look for `can_resend: true`). Only for a started campaign you created, and not while it is paused. A candidate who has completed or declined has nothing to resend. One send per candidate per minute.
errors: Campaign was made in the playground.
Campaign not started, paused, completed or cancelled; or the candidate has completed, declined or is not contacted yet.
A link was sent to this candidate less than a minute ago. Wait Retry-After seconds.

pauseCampaign.title: Pause a campaign
pauseCampaign.description: Emergency brake: nobody new is contacted until you resume.
errors: Campaign was made in the playground.
Not started yet, or not in a state that can be paused.

resumeCampaign.title: Resume a campaign
resumeCampaign.description: Continue a paused campaign: held-back people are contacted now.
errors: Campaign was made in the playground.
Not paused, or the job is archived.

listMandateCampaignsById.title: List mandate campaigns
listMandateCampaignsById.description: List the campaigns that were sent for one job.

listCampaignCandidates.title: List campaign candidates
listCampaignCandidates.description: One row per candidate: `candidate_id`, interested or not, progress, verdict and score, plus `delivery` (queued, sent, failed) and `can_resend`, so you can see who needs their link sent again. Phone numbers are never returned. A key with only `campaigns:write` gets the rows with `verdict`, `total_score` and `report_url` left null.

getCandidateResult.title: Get a candidate verdict
getCandidateResult.description: Verdict, score, a rating per skill and a report link. Add `include=answers` to also get what they said.

listCampaignResults.title: List campaign results
listCampaignResults.description: One record per candidate: `status` (pending, completed, declined, failed) and `output` with what Record collected. Prefer the webhook; use this to catch up or check.

getResult.title: Get a result
getResult.description: The same record the webhook delivers for this candidate.

createWebhookEndpoint.title: Create an endpoint
createWebhookEndpoint.description: Register the HTTPS URL that receives result events. Deliveries are signed with your API secret key.

fields.url: HTTPS, port 443, a public host. Any 2xx answer counts as the acknowledgement.
fields.backfill_from: ISO date-time: also send results from then on (at most 30 days back).

errors: URL not https, a private address, a port other than 443, or an unknown event type.

listWebhookEndpoints.title: List endpoints
listWebhookEndpoints.description: Each endpoint with its status (`active`, `paused`, `auto_paused`), consecutive failures and last success.

getWebhookEndpoint.title: Get an endpoint
getWebhookEndpoint.description: One endpoint with its current status.

updateWebhookEndpoint.title: Update an endpoint
updateWebhookEndpoint.description: Send only what changes. `status: paused` holds deliveries (nothing is lost); `status: active` resumes them, oldest first. Use it to bring back an `auto_paused` endpoint.
errors: No field sent, or a bad URL.

deleteWebhookEndpoint.title: Delete an endpoint
deleteWebhookEndpoint.description: Deliveries still waiting for it stop. The events stay in the feed for 30 days.

testWebhookEndpoint.title: Send a test event
testWebhookEndpoint.description: Sends a signed `webhook.test` right now and shows what your server answered. Not stored, not retried.

backfillWebhookEndpoint.title: Backfill past results
backfillWebhookEndpoint.description: Queues the results since `from` (at most 30 days back) as normal deliveries. Safe to repeat.

listWebhookDeliveries.title: List deliveries
listWebhookDeliveries.description: Every send to this endpoint, newest first: attempts, last HTTP status or error, when the next retry is due.

retryWebhookDelivery.title: Retry a delivery
retryWebhookDelivery.description: For a dead one after you fixed your endpoint. Its attempts count from zero again.

pullEvents.title: Pull and confirm events
pullEvents.description: One call does both jobs. Send the `ack` ids of the events you already processed, and get the next events back. An event keeps coming back until you put its id in `ack`. Use it when you cannot expose a URL, and as a safety net next to the webhook.

fields.ack: Ids of the events you processed. Leave it empty on your first call.
fields.status: `unacked` (default) gives only events you have not confirmed. `all` replays history (use it with `from`).
fields.from: Only events created at or after this time (replay).
fields.after: Only events with a higher `sequence` than this. A paging shortcut: rely on `unacked`.

errors: An `ack` id that is not an event id, more than 100 ids, a bad date, or `limit` above 100.

getEvent.title: Get an event
getEvent.description: Fetch one event by its id.
errors: No such event (or older than 30 days).

getWorkflowAnalytics.title: Get workflow analytics
getWorkflowAnalytics.description: The workflow Overview numbers from the Record playground. Add `mandate_id` and/or `campaign_id` to narrow it to one job or campaign; each must belong to this workflow.
errors: No such workflow, or the `mandate_id` / `campaign_id` does not belong to it.

getMandateAnalytics.title: Get mandate analytics
getMandateAnalytics.description: The same numbers for one job mandate, adding up all campaigns sent on it.

getCampaignAnalytics.title: Get campaign analytics
getCampaignAnalytics.description: The same numbers for one campaign: how that batch of candidates went.
